name: 联合军
desc: 自己场上的战士族怪兽的攻击力上升自己场上的战士族·魔法师族怪兽数量×200的数值。
faq: Multiple copies of "The A. Forces" are cumulative. For example, if you control 3 Warrior-Type monsters and have 2 copies of "The A. Forces" active, each Warrior-Type monster has its ATK increased by 1200 points.
ruling: "The A. Forces” continuously checks the number of appropriate monsters and alters ATK value accordingly
